messages.subject: Bug Found With Conditional Input
parts:
I was attempting to implement the code you posted back in May pertaining to changing the aspect ratio of a plot. (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/aspect$20ratio/shiny-discuss/ZmuZbQfJstg/qi4OnKktARMJ), but when I tried implementing it my screen would flicker.

I traced the cause to the conditional input condition.  For some reason, when "two" is chosen, the screen flickers.  When "one" is chosen, the flickering stops.  Here is the code for you to play with, and hopefully this will help you guys to fix the issue I am facing now:

UI
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Hello Shiny!"),

  sidebarPanel(
      radioButtons("type", "Select Type", c("One"="one","Two"="two"), selected = "Two"),
      #selectInput("type", "Select Type", c("One"="one","Two"="two"), selected = "Two"),
      conditionalPanel(
          #condition = "input.type == 'two'",
          condition = "input.type != 'two'",
          numericInput(inputId="myInput", label="Enter Number", value = NULL, min=1, step=1) 
      )
  ),

  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("distPlot", height='auto')
  )
))

Server
shinyServer(
  function(input, output, session){
      output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    
      input$type
        plot(1:10)
          }, height=function() { session$clientData$output_distPlot_width * 1.0 })
})

The other difficulty I am facing is that given the available functions I am unable to specify a width and height such that:

Height: The minimum of (Available Width * Height/Width Ratio) and Available Height
Width: The minimum of (Available Height* Width/Height Ratio) and Available Width.

The solution posted in the thread back from May requires the user to scroll down to view the plot in its entirety. It would be nice to have an argument such as session$clientData$output_foo_height, but the value is zero when I attempt to read it.
